Ethan Brooks: Heads-up — benchmark blog publish still set for 2026-04-05 09:00 PT (EMBARGO). Link to final draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-v2
Ethan Brooks: Problem: our image render queue backed up overnight, hi-res screenshots not available yet. Figma exports stalled on the render worker.
Aisha Khan: Ugh. How long is the queue? Do we have low-res fallbacks for social cards?
Lina Park: Render queue shows ~45 items ahead, ETA ~50m. I'm exporting low-res 1x PNGs now and adding alt text. Figma: https://figma.com/file/benchv2.
Tom Rivera: Can infra bump priority for these export jobs? infra-bot, any way to surface a temporary priority bump?
infra-bot: Received request. Priority escalation requires owner ack and will run during off-peak window. Current window available: +20 minutes. Confirm to proceed. (reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:)
Ethan Brooks: Do it. We need hi-res by 08:30 PT. If that fails, we fall back to low-res on the blog and replace later. Notify PressOps and syndication partners of any last-minute asset swap.
Aisha Khan: Syndication plan updated: Dev.to 09:05 PT, HN 09:10 PT, Partner.N 10:00 PT. If images swap to low-res, we'll delay HN to 09:15 to avoid noisy threads. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/press-windows
Lina Park: Export succeeded after priority bump. Hi-res PNGs now in the shared assets folder: https://assets.internal/bench/2026-04-05. Alt text added.
Tom Rivera: Preflight deploy check queued. deploy-bot will run sanity and link-check.
PressOps Bot: Draft social posts queued. Will hold send until @Ethan posts final "publish" command.
